ImportProjectPage.descriptionCsv: Creates one case per row in your CSV, in the folder you choose. Works with an export from any tool — no account or credentials needed. Steps and run/result history aren't part of this version.
ImportProjectPage.descriptionKiwiTcms: Recreates a Kiwi TCMS product's test plan tree as nested TestPulse folders, and its cases inside them — doesn't touch TestPulse's own Suite feature. A case linked to more than one test plan imports once, not once per plan. Run/result history isn't part of this version — see the note below.
ImportProjectPage.descriptionQase: Recreates Qase suites as nested folders, and Qase cases inside them — doesn't touch TestPulse's own Suite feature. Run/result history isn't part of this version — see the note below.
ImportProjectPage.descriptionTestrail: Recreates TestRail suites and sections as nested folders, and TestRail cases inside them — doesn't touch TestPulse's own Suite feature. Run/result history isn't part of this version — see the note below.
ImportProjectPage.descriptionTuskr: Recreates a Tuskr project's Test Suites as top-level TestPulse folders and its Sections as nested folders inside them, and Tuskr cases inside those — doesn't touch TestPulse's own Suite feature. Run/result history isn't part of this version — see the note below.
ImportProjectPage.descriptionXray: Recreates an Xray project's Test Repository folder tree as nested TestPulse folders, and its Tests inside them, with structured steps for Manual-type tests — doesn't touch TestPulse's own Suite feature. Supports both Xray Cloud and Server/Data Center. Test Sets, Test Plans, and Preconditions aren't part of this version — see the note below.
ImportProjectPage.descriptionZephyrScale: Recreates Zephyr Scale folders as nested TestPulse folders, and Zephyr Scale cases inside them — doesn't touch TestPulse's own Suite feature. Run/result history isn't part of this version — see the note below.
